Monthly Update Notes
Incoming Update
notes.notes:
To all commanders:

After several weeks of testing, we have received lots of feedback from players and we are working on lots of issues, balance adjustments, and new contents, so we decided to postpone this week’s update to the end of this month. Our goal is to provide a best game experience. Stay tuned, commanders.

Thank you
CASTLE BRAVO
